summary: Iteration 17 — Rename GroupUp -> Barrio VERIFIED across backend and frontend, zero regression. Backend: 14/14 new rename smoke tests pass (/app/backend/tests/test_rename_barrio.py) and 52/52 pre-existing tests keep passing (test_gender_filter.py 20 + test_google_auth_session.py 16 + test_expired_soft_delete.py 16). Root endpoint GET /api/ returns exactly {"message": "Barrio API"}. T&C rejection message on POST /api/groups for a user whose terms_version=null contains 'Barrio' (verified: 'Devi accettare il regolamento aggiornato di Barrio prima di continuare.'), and does not contain 'groupup'. Auth token guard intact: missing/malformed/unknown Bearer -> 401; a seeded valid session -> 200 /api/auth/me. POST /api/auth/session still validates session_id shape. Full group cycle (create -> join -> leave -> delete) works with seeded Google-Sign-In sessions. Gender-filter (female-only refuses male joiner, 403) and age-gate (adult group refuses minor, 403) still enforce. Admin: /api/admin/verify without secret rejected; with ADMIN_SECRET header returns {ok:true}. Reports: POST /api/reports creates then de-dupes with 409 as expected. Frontend: web preview http://localhost:3000 loads OK (HTTP 200), document.title == 'Barrio', body text contains 'Barrio' and does NOT contain 'GroupUp' (case-insensitive) anywhere on the login screen. Login-screen brand text 'Barrio' visible; opening the terms modal shows title 'Regolamento Barrio' and body text starts with 'REGOLAMENTO E LIMITAZIONE DI RESPONSABILITÀ – Barrio ... Versione 2026-06-01'. Grep across /app/frontend/app and /app/frontend/src confirms the ONLY remaining references to 'groupup' are the intentionally-preserved internal keys (session-store.ts key 'groupup_session_token', api.ts ADMIN_SECRET_KEY '@groupup/admin_secret', location.tsx STORAGE_KEY '@groupup/location_prefs_v1', app.json slug 'groupup', auth-callback.tsx deep-link scheme comment) — matches the PR intent (do not break existing sessions/AsyncStorage). Bundle identifier and Android package correctly updated to com.barrio.app; scheme -> 'barrio'. No visual/UI regression on login or terms modal.
action_items: None — rename is fully consistent and no regression detected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The four user-visible surfaces of the rename are (1) app.json (name/scheme/bundleId/android.package), (2) backend GET /api/ payload, (3) backend T&C rejection detail on POST /api/groups when terms_version != CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION, (4) frontend user-visible strings in app/login.tsx, app/onboarding.tsx, app/(tabs)/profile.tsx, src/lib/terms.ts. Internal storage keys are deliberately left as 'groupup_*' / '@groupup/*' to preserve existing sessions/AsyncStorage — do NOT flag these as regressions in future iterations. To test T&C rejection you must seed a user_sessions row whose user has terms_version=null (or != CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION='2026-06-01') and POST /api/groups; see _seed_user(accept_terms=False) helper.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug found.
